definitions: A statement that describes something as being much less significant, serious, or extreme than it actually is, often for ironic or humorous effect.
An extremely mild or inadequate description of something that is in reality very impressive, terrible, or otherwise remarkable.
examples: Calling the Grand Canyon 'a bit of a ditch' would be the understatement of the year.
To say that the company's profits were disappointing would be the understatement of the year; they lost millions.
Describing her performance as 'adequate' was the understatement of the year; she was absolutely brilliant.
